csharpCode: using UnityEngine; public class FindFloor { public static string Run() { UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshHit hit; if (UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.SamplePosition(Vector3.zero, out hit, 1000f, UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.AllAreas)) { return $"Found NavMesh at: {hit.position}"; } return "No NavMesh found!"; } }
